title: prevalence-imperfect-tests: R and Stan code and aggregate results for prevalence estimation with imperfect diagnostic tests
description: R and Stan code and aggregate results for the article 'Prevalence estimation with imperfect diagnostic tests: a comparison of frequentist and Bayesian logistic regression methods with misclassification correction using cross-sectional screening data'. The code compares standard logistic regression with Rogan-Gladen correction, the misclassification model of Liu and Zhang, and Bayesian logistic regression with external or internal correction, including prior sensitivity analyses and convergence diagnostics. Individual-level data are not included because they are not anonymized; they are available from the authors on reasonable request with the permission of the data owner.
